# Behance

> > Behance is Adobe's leading creative portfolio platform connecting designers, artists, and creatives with clients and opportunities worldwide.

Behance enables creative professionals to showcase their work, discover talent, and access freelance opportunities. The platform integrates with Adobe Portfolio and offers premium features through Behance Pro membership.

## Key Topics

- Creative portfolios
- Freelance marketplace
- Client discovery
- Adobe Portfolio integration
- Behance Pro membership
- Creative services
- Asset sales
- Designer networking
- Project showcases
- Talent discovery
- Creative community
- Work opportunities
